confidence_notes: Holistic July 2026 estimate for a highly tourist-facing beach district. Meals are more predictable than lodging, which varies widely by quality, season and beach proximity. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from typical bar premiums over local beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Kuta's mass-market Bali beach-tourism market, where local warung prices sit alongside resort-facing venues; lodging generally reflects a less upscale profile than Seminyak.
